Restatement of Policy. - The National Government
hereby reaffirms Its privatization policy to promote an orderly,

coordinated and efficient program for the privatization bi
government entities, assets or activities which are better
managed, undertaken or owned by.the private sector.

Privatization of GOCCs Approved for Disposition...
Pursuant to the principles provided in Proclamation No. 50,
1986, the COP designated disposition entities shall submit to
the COP a privatization action plan for all GOCCs approved for
divestment as listed in Annex "A" within one month (1) from
issuance hereof; Provided, that said action plan. must contain a
description of the privatization process to be adopted and a time
frame for each step thereof.
Said action plan shall include an
offer to sell the company's shares/assets within five (5) months
from Its approval by the COP.
3•

"B" hereof, and submit its recommendation
of companies, activities or assets thereof of a second group of
GOCCs for privatization, to the COP within two (2) months from
issuance hereof.

Designation of Disposition Entity
shall review the list of disposition entities designated for the
privatization of GOCCs and designate another disposition entity.
such as the APT or the National Development Company (NDC)
is necessary for the effective and expeditious privatization of
certain GOCCs.
Sale of Idle Government Properties.
Committees created pursuant to Administrative Order Nos. 8 and 9,
§ .
1992. shall submit Its recommended action plan for the
disposition of idle government properties to the President.
through the COP.
within three (3) months from issuance hereof.

Privatization of Other Activities. - All heads of
departments, bureaus, agencies and other government corporations
shall identify their assets or activities which may be more
efficiently.
effectively and economically undertaken by the
private sector through such arrangements as sale of physical
leasing of assets.
management and maintenance contracts
or build-operate-transfer (BOT) schemes.
Where these are within
their competence,
they shall Implement such privatization
Where these require actions of the Office of the
legislation,
they shall submit their
recommendations to the COP not later than three (3) months from
Issuance hereof. Where further assistance is needed, thev
consult the COP and avail of grants for technical assistance for
privatization.
administered by the Department of Finance.

Distribution of Net Proceeds -
subsidiaries of the Government
Service Insurance System and the
Social Security System, a11 GOCCs shall remit to the Nationad
Government at least fifty percent (50%) of the net proceeds
derived from the sale of shares or assets effective October It
1992.
Net proceeds shall mean gross proceeds less related
liabilities and selling expenses.

- Implementing Rules. -
The COP shall issue the
necessary rules and regulations, for the implementation of this
Order within thirty (30) days from issuance hereof.

Effectivity. -
This Order shall take effect
Immediately.
Done In the City of Manila, this
in the year of Our Lord, minciden hundred and ninety two.
day of December,
Executive Secretar
